data.headline: Indre Lewis — REALTOR® Associate
data.body: Indre is a REALTOR® Associate with Green Light Realty, serving buyers and sellers across Middlesex, Monmouth, and Ocean County. Reach out for local market expertise and guidance from first showing to closing day.

data.title: How Indre Helps
data.subtitle: Local expertise from first showing to closing day.

items.title: Local Market Expertise
items.description: Indre works Middlesex, Monmouth, and Ocean County every day — pricing, neighborhoods, schools, and what homes are really worth right now.

items.title: Guidance for Buyers & Sellers
items.description: Whether you are buying your first home or selling to move up, Indre walks you through every step so nothing catches you off guard.
